test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 3 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A question is given followed by two arguments. Decide which of the arguments is/are strong with respect to the question.

**Question:**

Should the illiterates be debarred from casting their votes?

**Arguments:**

I. Yes, they can be easily misguided.

Il. No, it is their constitutional right.

options.text: Both argument I and II are strong.
Neither argument I nor II is strong

solution:
**Explanation:**

Argument I. Yes, they can be easily misguided. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] False (This argument is negative with respect to basic human rights. We can educate them about the power of their votes but we can't debar them from casting their votes.)

Argument II. No, it is their constitutional right. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] True** **(Everyone has their constitutional right to vote.)

Hence, **Only argument II is strong **is the correct answer.
